title: Tool call plus tool result
notes: The assistant calls a tool, gets a result, then answers. The call has a boolean false argument on purpose: re-rendering it as Python False is a known multi-turn bug class (Prime Intellect, May 2026). Tool results must not be supervised.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a city.

celsius.description: Return the temperature in Celsius if true.

messages.content: What's the weather in Paris right now? Use Fahrenheit.
It's 64 degrees Fahrenheit in Paris right now, and it isn't raining.
